name: Active Hang
steps: Grasp a pull-up bar with a shoulder-width overhand grip and step off into a straight-arm hang.
Keep your elbows locked straight as you draw your shoulder blades firmly down and slightly back away from your ears.
Brace your core, keep your legs straight and together, and lift your chest slightly toward the bar.
Hold this engaged position steadily for the target duration before releasing gently back to a passive hang and stepping down.
tips: Keep your arms completely straight so the hold comes from depressing your shoulder blades rather than bending your elbows.
Avoid flaring your ribs or arching your lower back by keeping your abs lightly braced.
